expanded_prompts.sm-fanged-020-normal-attempt001.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original, gentle fantasy creature for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly ONE new full-body creature, not based on any existing character.
Locked v2 anatomy and materials: Exactly one low broad rounded rectangular body, not a hemisphere. Exactly five clearly separate small round felt-like tufts arranged on its upper back, all five countable. Soft fuzzy body surface and smooth facial skin. Exactly two round eyes, a gentle closed mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail. No fangs, teeth, ears, arms or wings.
Locked pose and personality: Rest low on four distinct legs, relaxed and leisurely, face image-right.
Palette roles primary / secondary / dark accent, respectively: #C5A7A0 / #F5E6BC / #645D78. Preserve the primary color on the main body, secondary on scales or tufts or soft wings, dark accent for contours and eyes.
Mandatory identifiers: low broad rounded rectangular body; exactly five separate round dorsal felt tufts; four short legs and one rounded leaf tail.
Style: clear variable-width dark colored outline, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, modest tactile material cues, appealing proportions. No photorealism or glossy 3D rendering.
Composition: full body, light top-down three-quarter view. Output MUST be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels RGBA PNG. Center the creature inside the central 80 percent of the square; its longest extent 800–850 pixels and at least 80 completely transparent pixels on each edge. Show all specified appendages distinctly, no cropping.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no glow. Depict only the creature; no habitat, rocks, leaves, props, clothing, scenery, text, letters, logos, watermarks, frames or extra anatomy.
expanded_prompts.sm-fanged-020-normal-attempt002.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image: the new original design-v2 candidate for sm-fanged-020, SHA256 2d4a032447de87a3bd84ed9adb8a4cf73bb2d61d17b6a86bc2fa54bd3da2d7dc. This request edits only this newly generated friendly creature.
Required targeted quality correction: Make all FOUR short legs visible and countable: two front and two rear, with the currently hidden far rear foot visibly projecting just below the body. Exactly four distinct foot ends, never three or five. Keep the five separate round dorsal felt tufts, two eyes, low broad rounded rectangular body and one rounded leaf tail unchanged.
Keep all other anatomy, proportions, palette placement, viewing angle, pose and expression the same.
Complete design constraints: Exactly one low broad rounded rectangular body, not a hemisphere. Exactly five clearly separate small round felt-like tufts arranged on its upper back, all five countable. Soft fuzzy body surface and smooth facial skin. Exactly two round eyes, a gentle closed mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail. No fangs, teeth, ears, arms or wings.
Palette: #C5A7A0 / #F5E6BC / #645D78.
Maintain a clean hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration with a dark outline and restrained three-step cel shading. Full body, one character, transparent background. Do not add any scene, objects, text or extra body features.
Output must be a 1024 by 1024 RGBA PNG. Center the subject with at least 80 pixels entirely transparent on every edge, its longest extent 800–850 pixels. No cropped parts, ground, shadow, glow, watermark or frames.
expanded_prompts.sm-fanged-020-pixel-attempt001.txt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one authentic 128x128 pixel-art creature sprite.
Input image is the sole identity reference, sm-fanged-020 design v2, SHA256 70221f72a1a418966399e35a51e939b37894b4fdbb323552214eb78ffa3a4196. Redraw this exact creature as deliberately constructed pixel art. Change only the medium. Do not redesign and do not simply pixelate or downsample the painting.
Locked anatomy and materials: Exactly one low broad rounded rectangular body, not a hemisphere. Exactly five clearly separate small round felt-like tufts arranged on its upper back, all five countable. Soft fuzzy body surface and smooth facial skin. Exactly two round eyes, a gentle closed mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly one short rounded leaf-shaped tail. No fangs, teeth, ears, arms or wings.
Locked pose: Rest low on four distinct legs, relaxed and leisurely, face image-right. Match the reference's exact proportions, limb placements, silhouette, face, viewing angle and direction.

Identifiers: low broad rounded rectangular body; exactly five separate round dorsal felt tufts; four short legs and one rounded leaf tail.
Output an exact 128 by 128 RGBA PNG master, not an upscaled preview. Use a true regular 1-pixel grid, thoughtful color clusters, consistent 1–2 pixel outlines and stepped contours. At most 32 opaque RGB colors, alpha exactly 0 or 255, no antialiasing, blur, gradients or semi-transparent pixels. No ground, shadow, glow, background, text, letters, watermark, frame, props, extra anatomy or extra objects. Never add decorative leaves at wing roots or body markings that are not in this reference.
